view.name: RecordIdsType
view.text: IF type_id('dbo.Record_Ids') IS NULL CREATE TYPE dbo.Record_Ids AS TABLE ( Id int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY )

procedure.name: Locko_PrepareDealScore
procedure.text: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.Locko_PrepareDealScore AS SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED BEGIN SELECT -- Номер договора contract_number = cb.Number, scoring = tp.Scoring FROM dbo.Locko_Application la LEFT JOIN dbo.M_LA_TransactionParticipants AS tps ON la.Id = tps.Parent LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_TransactionParticipant AS tp ON tps.Child = tp.Id LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_ContractBase AS cb ON la.CreditContract = cb.Id WHERE tp.TransactionRole = 2 AND la.ApplicationStatus = 9 RETURN 0 END

procedure.name: Locko_GetApplicationInfo
procedure.text:
CREATE PROC dbo.Locko_GetApplicationInfo @record_id int AS SET NOCOUNT ON SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED BEGIN
SELECT record_id = a.Id, -- Номер заявки number = a.ApplicationNumber, -- Дата создания заявки date_create = a.CreationDate, -- Клиент client_name = tp.FullName, -- Наименование name = a.Name, -- Подразделение branch_name = b.Name, -- Филиал filial_name = f.Name, -- Регион region_name = r.Name, -- Статус status = st.Name FROM dbo.Locko_Application a LEFT JOIN Locko_ApplicationStatus st ON st.Id = a.ApplicationStatus LEFT JOIN dbo.v_Locko_TransactionParticipants tp ON tp.Application = a.Id AND tp.TransactionRole = 2 -- основной заёмщик LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Branch b ON b.Id = a.Branch LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Branch f ON f.Id = a.Filial LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Branch r ON r.Id = a.Region WHERE a.Id = @record_id
RETURN 0 END

procedure.name: Locko_GetApplicationsInfos
procedure.text:
CREATE PROC dbo.Locko_GetApplicationsInfos @record_ids Record_Ids READONLY AS SET NOCOUNT ON SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED BEGIN
SELECT record_id = a.Id, -- Номер заявки number = a.ApplicationNumber, -- Дата создания заявки date_create = a.CreationDate, -- Клиент client_name = tp.FullName, -- Наименование name = a.Name, -- Подразделение branch_name = b.Name, -- Филиал filial_name = f.Name, -- Регион region_name = r.Name, -- Статус status = st.Name FROM dbo.Locko_Application a INNER JOIN @record_ids rec ON rec.Id = a.Id LEFT JOIN Locko_ApplicationStatus st ON st.Id = a.ApplicationStatus LEFT JOIN dbo.v_Locko_TransactionParticipants tp ON tp.Application = a.Id AND tp.TransactionRole = 2 -- основной заёмщик LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Branch b ON b.Id = a.Branch LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Branch f ON f.Id = a.Filial LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Branch r ON r.Id = a.Region
RETURN 0 END

script.name: ix_PublicClientSession__SessionToken
